output.instructions: Record one everyday task per clip, start to finish, with your hands and the task in frame. Prop the phone up or have someone hold it. No editing, no music, no faces needed.

pay.text: USD 1 per clip after verification; samples are unpaid

questions.question: How many hours a week can you give this?

how_to: Pick one task you really do: make tea, fold five shirts, tighten a loose screw, wipe a counter.
Prop the phone against a cup or a wall at chest height, or ask someone to hold it. Turn the lights on.
Hold the phone sideways (landscape). Check that your hands and the whole work area are in the frame.
Press record, wait two seconds, then do the task from start to finish in one take. No cuts.
Stop when the task is done. Watch it back: hands visible all the way, under 60 seconds, not blurry.
requirements.looks_like: A 40-second clip looking down at a kitchen counter: two hands fill a kettle, pour the water into a cup with a tea bag and stir. Steady phone, good light, no music.
rules: One real task per clip, filmed by you, in one take.
No other people in the frame unless they agree to it.
No editing, speed changes, filters or music.
Samples are unpaid. They only verify that you can do the task and that the content is your own.
Make every sample yourself, for this task, now. No downloads, stock, screenshots of other people's content, AI-generated or reused files.
No filters, edits, music or captions unless the task asks for them.
Nobody else's face, voice, screen or personal details without their consent, and never children.
One account per person. Samples that break these rules are rejected and the account can be closed.
Once your samples are verified, paid work is offered at the task's rate or the rate you asked for. Only that work is paid.

pay.text: USD 0.25 per photo after verification; samples are unpaid

questions.question: Which city are the photos from?
How new is your phone camera?

how_to: Food: photograph a real meal from above or at an angle, in natural light, before you eat it. Two photos.
Receipt: lay a paper receipt flat and cover names, card numbers and loyalty numbers with a finger or a sticker, then photograph it straight on. One photo.
Street: stand still and photograph a street scene: shopfronts, a crossing, a market. Two photos.
Use the normal camera app, no filters, no screenshots. Sharp and well lit.
Send the five photos one at a time.
requirements.looks_like: A plate of rice and curry photographed from above; a shop receipt with the card number hidden; a busy street with shops and a bus.
rules: Photos you took yourself in the last 30 days; no downloads, no screenshots.
Hide every name, phone number and card or account number on a receipt.
No close-up faces of strangers; general street scenes are fine.
